name: docker-deploy
description: Build a Docker image, push it to the project's GitLab container registry on the default branch, then run the repository's own deploy script for one environment. A pipeline the platform starts with ORCH_DEPLOY_ENV runs only that deploy, for the build it names: that is how a build is promoted or rolled back. Needs a runner that allows Docker-in-Docker.

dockerVersion.description: Tag of the docker and docker:dind images that build the image.

dockerfile.description: Path of the Dockerfile, from the repository root.

context.description: Build context directory, from the repository root.

environment.description: The environment a merge to the default branch deploys to: its slug, which is the name GitLab gives it.

deployScript.description: The repository's script that deploys, from the repository root. It gets IMAGE, IMAGE_TAG, ORCH_DEPLOY_ENV and ORCH_DEPLOY_SHA, and must be safe to run twice for one build.

deployImage.description: The image the deploy job runs in: it needs the script's own tools, and curl when ORCH_HEALTH_URL is set.
